verses.translation: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come
for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—
from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent

verses.arabicText: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin
verses.translation: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length
So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience
They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible
but We see it as inevitable
On that Day the sky will be like molten brass
and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool
And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends

verses.arabicText: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīh
verses.translation: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children
their spouses, their siblings
their clan that sheltered them

verses.arabicText: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.transliteration: Waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīh
verses.translation: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves
But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame
ripping off scalps
It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺
and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺
Indeed, humankind was created impatient
distressed when touched with evil
and withholding when touched with good—
except those who pray
consistently performing their prayers
and who give the rightful share of their wealth
to the beggar and the poor
and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment

verses.arabicText: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūn
verses.translation: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—
˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—
and those who guard their chastity

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.transliteration: Illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīn
verses.translation: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame

verses.arabicText: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.transliteration: Famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūn
verses.translation: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants
and who are honest in their testimony
and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers
These will be in Gardens, held in honour
So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺
from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺

verses.arabicText: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-im-min'hum ay-yud'khala jannata naʿīmin
verses.translation: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss
But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from

verses.arabicText: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūn
verses.translation: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable

verses.arabicText: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.transliteration: ʿalā an-nubaddila khayram-min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīn
verses.translation: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺

verses.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūn
verses.translation: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubiy-yūfiḍūn
verses.translation: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺

verses.arabicText: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūn
verses.translation: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of
